description: Convert CSV text into a JSON array, following standard CSV quoting rules for embedded commas, quotes and line breaks. With headers on, the first row becomes object keys; with headers off, each row is an array of strings. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/csv-to-json/

firstRowHeaders.description: When true, the first row supplies the object keys; when false, every row becomes a plain array of strings (default true)

name: hopi_csv_to_json

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: CSV to JSON converter
